Extract vocalization motifs

Source: R/motif.R
find_motif.Rd

A generic function to extract fixed-window motif segments centered around template detection timestamps. For a lys object, detection hits are mapped to enclosing labeled bouts (e.g. from annotate_vocalizations or map_vocalization_sessions) so each extracted motif inherits the behavioral condition (e.g. "PD SongBout" vs. "UD SongBout").

Usage

find_motif(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
find_motif(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lys'
find_motif(
  x,
  template_name,
  pre_time = NULL,
  lag_time = NULL,
  bout_labels = c("PD SongBout", "UD SongBout"),
  label_map = NULL,
  tolerance_sec = 0.05,
  check_duration = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A lys object or a data frame containing detection timestamps.

...

Additional arguments passed to specific methods.

template_name

Character. Name of the template in x$templates$template_matches.

pre_time

Numeric. Time in seconds before the detection point.

lag_time

Numeric. Time in seconds after the detection point.

bout_labels

Character vector of bout labels to retain. If NULL, all bouts are included. Default is c("PD SongBout", "UD SongBout").

label_map

Optional named character vector to re-map bout labels (e.g., c("PD SongBout" = "PD", "UD SongBout" = "UD")).

tolerance_sec

Numeric. Tolerance in seconds when matching detection timestamps to bout boundaries. Default 0.05.

check_duration

Logical. If TRUE (default), verifies motif bounds against audio file duration on disk if the files exist.

verbose

Logical. Whether to print extraction progress. Default TRUE.

Value

For a lys object, the updated object containing extracted motifs in lys$motifs (returned invisibly). For the default method, a data frame of motif segments.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Extract motifs for PD and UD song bouts
lys <- find_motif(
  lys,
  template_name = "song",
  pre_time = 0.4,
  lag_time = 0.6,
  bout_labels = c("PD SongBout", "UD SongBout"),
  label_map = c("PD SongBout" = "PD", "UD SongBout" = "UD")
)
head(lys$motifs)
} # }
